### About
Personal site of Guanshan — Senior Backend Engineer at Tencent Cloud. Focused on enterprise agent platform architecture and LLM application engineering: Agent Runtime, RAG, MCP, cloud sandbox, multi-tenant AI platforms.

### Source of Truth
All copy lives in `BRAND.md` first, then is synced into `index.html`.

### Deploying
Push to `master` and GitHub Pages will update the site at `https://guanshan.github.io`.
note: Don't delete this file! It's used internally to help with page regeneration.
